sources.national_sd: Final-2-week generic-ballot average vs national House vote, 2006-2024: RMSE 2.84, SD 2.27 (538 generic_topline_historical.csv)
sources.generic_ballot_bias_adj: That average overstated Democrats by 1.85 pts, in 7 of 10 cycles (standard error ~0.7). Half is applied; the full and zero versions are scenarios
sources.regional_sd: Census-region share of district error ~1.0-1.3; state-level clustering ~3.1 (538 election-results recompute); 2.0 used
sources.fundamentals_sd: Residual SD of partisan lean + national swing + incumbency in competitive seats 6.2, ~5.5 with past overperformance (2016-2024 panel recompute)
sources.fundamentals_sd_open: Measured 5.5 on only 86 open seats; set to 6.0 since open seats are less predictable (538)
sources.fundamentals_sd_new: 2022 redistricting year had the highest incumbent residual SD, 6.5
sources.poll_state_sd: Nonpartisan district-poll error net of the national miss, 4.2-5.8 (538 raw_polls 2006-2022, final 21 days)
sources.single_poll_sd: Within-race spread of independent district polls 4.9-5.8
sources.partisan_shift: Released internals lean toward the sponsor by 4.4 (D) to 5.6 (R); 4.6-4.8 vs independent polls of the same race; 538 assumes 4
sources.incumbency_bonus: Regression estimates 4.0-6.1 are inflated by selection; Split Ticket ~3 (2024), Annotations 2.6; 3.0 used
sources.overperformance_shrink: 0.38-0.71 of a member's overperformance persisted on the same lines; not applied on substantially new lines
sources.elasticity_k: Swing near-uniform to a lean of ~30, 0.5-0.9x in the most partisan seats; fitted k 0.17-0.77; 0.25 used
sources.t_df: Fundamentals residuals have excess kurtosis 1.23 (implies ~9 df); 8 used
sources.national_shift: Generic ballot D+8.7 (Oct 2026 average) minus 2024 national presidential margin R+1.5
sources.overperf_cap: Judgment: 2024 results of 60+ points (usually uncontested) are ignored, and carried-forward overperformance is capped at ±15 so one odd race can't dominate
